headline: DeepSeek holds 32.1% of tokens while Meta sets a fresh all-time record at 2.6%
summary: DeepSeek remains the heavyweight champ, pulling 32.1% of tokens and holding the No. 1 model slot at 22.3%. Meta's muse-spark-1.3-contributor set a new all-time token-share high at 2.6%, and a new DeepSeek entrant barged in straight at seventh place.
highlights: The top three providers, DeepSeek, Zhipu AI and Anthropic, hold 52.7% of tokens between them.
meta/muse-spark-1.3-contributor-20260902 posted an all-time token-share record of 2.6%, a first-day record rather than a continuing streak.
DeepSeek's deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 debuted at No. 7 with 3.7% of tokens, the day's most notable newcomer.
anthropic/claude-opus-5-20260723 climbed 11 places in a day to No. 30.
StepFun's stepfun/step-5-preview-20261008 dropped off the board after sitting at No. 24, and several OpenAI variants fell out of the top 50.
